findings.title: Catalog HMAC corruption test has no catalog MAC/key contract
findings.evidence: §93 requires a bad-catalog-HMAC negative. §42 defines only per-case HMAC keys and does not define a catalog key, MAC construction, canonical encoding, rotation/lifetime, or update recovery. A per-case key cannot authenticate the catalog before opening the case and retrieving that key.
findings.required_change: Define the supervisor-owned catalog integrity key lifecycle and canonical MAC/update contract with a golden vector, or remove the HMAC-specific test and specify strict schema/file-identity guarantees as the catalog integrity mechanism. Preserve global fail-closed on catalog read/write/Sync failures.
